recognizableElements: warm cream and restrained bronze accent

website.reason: Official source for brand facts, real procedures and real work. Final derivatives use a unified crop and grade.

social.reason: Use social channels to discover real people, work and atmosphere. Each image still requires quality, rights and palette review.

maps.reason: Useful for real branch context. Customer-uploaded images are not assumed reusable.

bookingSystem.reason: Altegio is authoritative for current staff identity. Real portraits are normalized; missing portraits use branded non-human placeholders.

ownerMaterials.reason: Original high-resolution files supplied by EVO supersede compressed public copies when provenance is clear.

artDirection.name: EVO Quiet Premium
photographyStyle: real procedures and real specialists for proof sections
official real imagery preferred for category navigation when quality is sufficient
generation remains a fallback for non-evidentiary covers when no suitable real source exists
lighting: no harsh cyan or magenta salon lighting
composition: detail close-ups paired with occasional environment frames
peopleStyle: real EVO specialists wherever a named person is shown
backgrounds: clean real salon environment when source quality permits

contentVisualRules.portfolio: Only real sourced work. Generated images must never be presented as EVO client results or before/after evidence.
contentVisualRules.specialists: Use real specialist portraits. If the source system has no portrait, use a branded non-human placeholder until a real image is supplied.
contentVisualRules.serviceCovers: Prefer audited real EVO source imagery normalized into one visual system. Generated editorial covers are allowed only when no suitable real source exists and never as treatment outcome evidence.
contentVisualRules.interiors: Prefer real EVO interiors. If no reusable real interior exists, use brand graphic composition instead of fabricating a fake EVO location.
contentVisualRules.medicalBeauty: Avoid graphic procedure imagery, unsafe technique depictions and claims implied only by imagery.

aspectRatios.serviceCover: 4:5 master; UI may crop to 4:3 or compact thumbnail

consistencyRules.cropPolicy: Keep face, hands, nails, hair result or treatment focus inside the central safe zone; avoid edge-cut fingers, tools and faces.
consistencyRules.colorPolicy: All final UI imagery must sit within a warm-neutral palette compatible with #F8F6F1, #49600B and #BC936C. Correct source white balance before use.
consistencyRules.retouchPolicy: Correct exposure, color and crop. Preserve real texture and do not materially alter treatment results.
consistencyRules.realPeoplePolicy: Preserve real staff identity; do not generate replacement faces for named real specialists.
consistencyRules.socialStylePolicy: Social media is a source, not an automatic design system. Copy its visual language only when the audit explicitly approves it.
